title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Connecticut College
description: An under-21-safe guide to the late-night dining and study spots that define the student experience at Connecticut College in New London.

cards.title: Oasis Snack Shop
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Hub in Crozier-Williams
cards.notes: Visit the first floor of 'Cro' for made-to-order burgers, fries, and sushi. It is a primary social hub for students seeking a study break or a late meal.
cards.short_summary: A central student hangout in the College Center offering diverse grill and grab-and-go options late into the evening.
cards.evidence_claim: Oasis is located on the first floor of Crozier-Williams and is described as a late-night hangout spot for students with made-to-order meals.
cards.access_notes: Open late during the academic semester; check CamelWeb for specific nightly hours.

cards.title: Coffee Grounds
cards.subtitle: Student-Run Cafe in Katharine Blunt House
cards.notes: Stop by for organic fair-trade coffee and homemade baked goods. This student-managed space often hosts open mics and club events until 10 PM.
cards.short_summary: A sustainable, student-run coffee shop located in KB House that serves as a vibrant evening community and performance space.
cards.evidence_claim: Coffee Grounds is open Monday through Thursday and Sunday until 10:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10 PM Sunday-Thursday during the academic year.

cards.title: Shain Library
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Study Space
cards.notes: Utilize the first-floor cafe area for all-night study sessions. The library provides a robust wireless network and plenty of outlets for late-night productivity.
cards.short_summary: The campus's main library features a first-floor area that serves as a 24-hour study space for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Blue Camel Café area in Shain Library doubles as a 24-hour study space.
cards.source_title: Charles E. Shain Library - Connecticut College
cards.access_notes: The first-floor cafe area is accessible 24 hours a day for student study.

cards.title: Harris Refectory
cards.subtitle: Main Dining Hall Late Hours
cards.notes: Head to the Plex for late-night dining options on select evenings. The Social House at Harris offers pizza, grill items, and a dedicated vegetarian station.
cards.short_summary: The college's primary dining hall, recently transformed into the Social House, offering evening meal service for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: Harris Refectory (Social House) offers dinner and has been noted for late-night dining availability until 10 PM on Sundays.
cards.access_notes: Regular dinner until 7:15 PM; check CamelWeb for specific late-night dining dates and extended hours.

cards.title: 7-Eleven
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Convenience on Broad Street
cards.notes: Walk or drive down to Broad Street for 24-hour access to snacks, drinks, and basic essentials. It is a reliable off-campus stop for late-night needs.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store located near campus providing round-the-clock access to food and supplies.
cards.evidence_claim: The 7-Eleven at 283 Broad Street in New London is open 24/7.

cards.title: Denny's
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Diner Classics
cards.notes: Gather a group for a late-night Grand Slam or milkshake. This diner is open 24/7 and is a classic destination for students after evening events.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner located on South Frontage Road offering a full breakfast, lunch, and dinner menu at any hour.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's at 322 S Frontage Road in New London is open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Denny's 322 S FRONTAGE ROAD I-95 RESTAURANT

cards.title: Domino's Pizza
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Delivery Staple
cards.notes: Order pizza, wings, or cheesy bread for delivery directly to your residence hall. They serve the campus community well past midnight on weekends.
cards.short_summary: A popular late-night delivery option for students, offering a full menu of pizza and sides until the early morning hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Domino's at 938 Bank Street is open until 1:00 AM or later for delivery and carryout.
cards.source_title: 938 Bank Street in New London - Domino's Pizza
cards.access_notes: Open until 1 AM daily, with extended hours on Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: CVS Pharmacy
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Essentials on Bank St
cards.notes: Pick up snacks, beverages, or health supplies until 9 PM. While not 24 hours, it is a key stop for students before the late-night study grind begins.
cards.short_summary: A conveniently located pharmacy and convenience store on Bank Street for evening supplies and snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: The CVS at 817 Bank Street is open until 9:00 PM daily.
cards.source_title: CVS Pharmacy at 817 Bank Street New London, CT 06320

cards.title: McDonald's
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Drive-Thru
cards.notes: Swing through the drive-thru for a quick late-night meal. Located on Colman Street, it is a frequent stop for students with access to a car.
cards.short_summary: A classic fast-food option with late-night drive-thru service located a short drive from the campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 406 Colman Street offers late-night hours and drive-thru service.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru typically open late; check the app for current nightly closing times.

cards.title: Ruane's Den
cards.subtitle: South Campus Coffee Spot
cards.notes: Visit the Walk-In Coffee Closet for a caffeine boost on South Campus. This student-run spot in Harkness House provides a cozy evening atmosphere for studying.
cards.short_summary: A student-managed coffee shop located in Harkness Residence Hall, serving the south end of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Ruane's Den is a student-run cafe located in Harkness House and is part of the Conn Coffee organization.
cards.access_notes: Open during the academic year; check CamelWeb for current student-staffed hours.
